evidence.evidence_summary: User-facing buttons trigger the pipeline and the page presents a live demo interface.
Button handlers start the pipeline or the deliberate leak simulation.
Creates and maintains forward/reverse mappings between raw values and indexed tokens.
Uses tokenVault.hasToken to confirm a semantic token exists for sensitive elements.
The demo page contains visible input fields for name, email, password, card number, phone, and total amount.
Iterates over supplied elements and computes a bounding box for each.
Maintains in-memory forward, reverse, and counter maps internal to the vault.
Stores token vaults per session id with TTL-based lifecycle management.
Maps detected sensitivity types to tier 1/2/3 and emits semantic tokens for tier 1 or 2.
Stores sensitivity_tier in the DOM summary for each element.
Creates indexed tokens like [TYPE_N] and reuses them for repeated raw values.
Assigns semantic_token for tier 1 and 2 sensitivities, optionally via the token vault.
Builds expected-redaction set only for sensitive elements that have a semantic token.
Only tier 1 or 2 elements are added to redacted regions and sensitive raw values.
Returns sensitivity_tier in the 1/2/3 model.
Applies ordered heuristics for password, card number, email, amount, phone, and name.
Detects EMAIL, PHONE, CARD_NUMBER, AADHAAR, IFSC, and OTP patterns.
Flags raw PII matches and unredacted secrets in sensitive paths.
Recursively asserts that raw sensitive values do not appear in the output object tree.
Reports mismatches when structural redaction is claimed without visual coverage or when visual redaction appears without structural sensitivity.
The demo runs assertChannelsConsistent and logs pass/fail based on agreement.
Imports the processing and audit modules into the demo page.
Takes elements and a source canvas/image as inputs.
Builds dom_summary.elements and redacted_regions from inspected elements.
Outputs sensitivity_tier, sensitivity_type, and semantic_token.
Overlays black rectangles onto the output canvas for sensitive regions.
Throws to block a network request when payload audit finds violations.
Constructs the declared output object shape.
Blocks payloads containing raw PII before transport.
Throws when structural and visual redactions do not agree.
Demo page exposes a checkout-like form with name, email, password, card, phone, and amount fields.
Main redaction orchestrator over DOM inputs, PII, token vault, canvas redaction, and recursive privacy assertion.
Audits payloads for raw PII and prevents transport on violations.
Checks that structural and visual redaction channels agree and throws on mismatch.
Manages session-scoped token vault lifecycle with TTL cleanup.
